title: E8 product codebooks for latent quantization
summary: Compare product quantization built from scaled E8 lattice cells with learned and cubic codebooks at equal rate, parameter count, and decoder compute.
hypothesis: The E8 product codebook will reduce validation reconstruction error by at least 3 percent relative to the strongest rate-matched control without lowering downstream task accuracy.
novelty: E8 is used only where its proven eight-dimensional packing geometry supplies a concrete inductive bias; the experiment tests that bias against learned and ordinary lattice controls.
